title: Sovra Factory ComponentVersionLock freeze (FTF-R001)
description: Frozen contract for pinned component/package/image versions (Section 77.5: 'Exact versions are installation inputs resolved by the qualification task, not latest tags or fictional example hashes'). A ComponentVersionLockSet must lock exactly the seven canonical component keys, exactly once each. No entry may carry a mutable tag such as 'latest', 'main', 'master' or 'HEAD' for its package_version, and image_digest/configuration_digest must be a real content digest, not a mutable tag (Section 84.7: 'mutable dashboard tags ... are not release proof').

package_version.description: An exact pinned semantic version. Mutable tags (latest/main/master/HEAD) never match this pattern.

image_digest.description: A real content-addressed digest, not a mutable tag.
